sections.heading: 1. Site Owner
paragraphs: The website emmchier.com (hereinafter, "the Site") is owned by Emmanuel Chierchié (hereinafter, "the Owner").

This site acts exclusively as a personal hub and entry point for the Owner's professional and creative work. It does not host portfolio content directly — instead, it links to two independent sub-domain sites: art.emmchier.com (illustration and digital art portfolio) and design.emmchier.com (UX/UI design and development portfolio).
Each sub-domain site has its own legal notice governing the content published therein.

The artistic and design works referenced or linked from this site are published on their respective sub-domain sites (art.emmchier.com and design.emmchier.com) and are protected under Argentine Law No. 11,723 on Intellectual Property and applicable international regulations. Please refer to each site's legal notice for the specific terms governing those works.
The following actions are strictly prohibited without prior, express, and written authorisation from the Owner:
list: Reproducing or copying the Owner's identity, branding, or any content linked from this site.
Using the content for promotional, advertising, or commercial purposes without authorisation.
Removing or altering authorship credits.

sections.heading: 3. Prohibition of Scraping, Data Mining, and AI Use
paragraphs: The following is expressly prohibited:
list: Automated scraping of the website's content.
Mass extraction of text, links, or metadata.
Incorporating the content into databases.

sections.heading: 4. External Links

The Owner is not responsible for the content, availability, or privacy practices of any external websites. Users access those sites at their own risk and under the terms established by each service.

sections.heading: 5. Use of the Website
paragraphs: Accessing and browsing this website implies acceptance of these terms.
The user agrees to use the website lawfully and to refrain from any actions that may affect its operation, security, or integrity.
The Owner may modify the content of the website at any time without prior notice.

sections.heading: 6. Cookies and Analytics
paragraphs: This website uses measurement tools through Google Tag Manager (GTM-P5KL5JZM), which may involve the use of technical or analytical cookies.
These tools allow the collection of general browsing statistics such as:
list: Pages visited
Time spent on the site
Device type and browser
Country or region (no precise geolocation)
paragraphsAfterList: No personally identifiable data is collected directly.

Users may configure their browser to reject cookies or use browser extensions to block tracking. For more information on how Google processes this data, refer to Google's Privacy Policy at policies.google.com/privacy.

sections.heading: 7. Personal Data Protection
paragraphs: This website does not request or store personal data through forms or registration systems.
If users contact the Owner through external channels (social media, email, or other platforms), such interaction will be governed by the privacy policies of those respective services.
The Owner commits to not sharing, selling, or disclosing any personal data obtained through external communication channels.

The Owner shall not be held liable for any direct or indirect damages arising from the use of, or inability to use, this website or the external sites it links to.

sections.heading: 9. Applicable Law and Jurisdiction
paragraphs: These terms are governed by the laws of the Argentine Republic.
Any dispute shall be submitted to the jurisdiction of the ordinary courts with competence in the Argentine Republic.

sections.heading: 10. Acceptance
paragraphs: Accessing, browsing, and using this website implies that the user has read and accepted these terms.
